summary.text: Robert Moesinger is an unaffiliated candidate for Utah's 2nd Congressional District. A systems and automation engineer who describes himself as not a politician, he is running primarily on replacing the two-party system with multi-party democracy, including ranked choice voting in multi-member House districts.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Ogden High School and earned a graduate degree from the University of Utah in 2018.
Works as a systems and automation engineer, studying manufacturing systems, analyzing data and correcting process flaws, according to his survey.
Describes himself as a first-time, non-politician candidate and a Utah father who plays board games with his family; says his faith is the foundation of his moral framework.
